ItemID: unavailable; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I want to explore more Tool; the heavy, intricate sound fits my current mood.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: It's All In Your Head; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic alternative rock fits, but I would prioritize heavier albums this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Glorious Burden; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The metal sound interests me, though I am less drawn to its historical themes right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Last in Line; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for a more modern heavy sound rather than classic metal today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Iowa       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its abrasive intensity appeals to the heavier side of my listening, especially after Death Cult Armageddon.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Godsmack       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves fit my interest in Disturbed, but other selections appeal more this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Heavy riffs with melodic hooks fit my interest in Chuck and The Reason, so I would try it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Once; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The combination of melody and metal sounds appealing, but I am less interested in a theatrical sound today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Finger Eleven; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic hard rock feels like a good follow-up to One Thing Remains and Elocation.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Art of Drowning; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its punk emphasis is less appealing than the heavier rock and metal I want right now.
